The '''Ancient Rakatan Keep''' was the name given to the largest region of [[the Tomb]], a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] built by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. It was dominated by the massive [[Zedalus Tree]], with the Rakata facility that the [[Esh-kha]] termed [[Cave-Under-Tree]] located beneath it. The other, smaller regions of the Tomb were all accessible from the keep, which was a verdant valley heated by several magma rifts.

==Behind the scenes==
The Ancient Rakatan Keep appears as a subregion of the Tomb on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
